description.content: Retrieves orders from the Cordial database. Using query string parameters, it is possible to filter the response by contact ID (`cID`) or `email` address value to retrieve all orders for a single contact. In addition, the response can be filtered by a specified order purchase date or date range. The GET /orders endpoint can retrieve up to 10,000 records at a time. To page through more than 10,000 records, multiple queries must be made with manually adjusted parameters for each.

query.description: Fields to include (can be many, comma-separated).
Filter records for a specific contact using the Cordial database contact ID (cID) value.
Filter records for a specific contact using the email address value.
Order purchase date (ISO 08601 date format e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss).
Filter orders that occurred before this time (ISO 08601 date format e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss).
Filter orders that occurred after this time (ISO 08601 date format e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss).
Filter orders that occurred before or at this time (ISO 08601 date format e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss).
Filter orders that occurred after or at this time (ISO 08601 date format e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss).
Specific page number to be returned.
Number or records per page.
Field by which results should be sorted.
Direction to sort by. Works in conjunction with `sort_by` (e.g. asc, desc).
Show the total count of records returned.

response.name: successful operation
